claim: The ecological-forward-test skill is complete enough to run ecological case generation, forward testing, failure summarizing, root-reason analysis, and continued improvement (surgical patch loop) across agent harnesses, without critical missing procedure.

criteria.text: Ecological case generation is defined and required as the primary suite (not lab-only explicit $skill prompts).

evidence.source: SKILL.md §2 Build ecological cases + Done when
evidence.quote: An ecological case is a session-like next turn... Lab/explicit invoke is optional control only, never the primary suite. Done when: ≥1 positive ecological case + ≥1 negative case written
Primary evidence | Ecological / session-like cases, not easy explicit `$skill` lab prompts
Lab explicit invoke is allowed as a control... It never alone proves auto-invoke or caller discipline.

gaps: Negative-case depth is thin: only a boolean `negative: true if skill must NOT run` (ecological-cases.md) and a minimum of one case. No classes of non-fire (wrong domain, already-done, ambiguous probe, competing skill), no required boundary coverage—weak for primary-suite quality but does not falsify that ecological generation is defined and required.
criteria.suggestion: Keep c1 as-is for generation/primary-suite; deepen negatives under case design (types + minimum matrix) so the primary suite is not one shallow non-fire.

criteria.text: Forward-test integrity is specified (fresh threads, no gold leakage, runner not told it is testing).

evidence.quote: Run cases on a fresh agent thread per case. Subagent / runner must not know it is testing... Pass raw probe and prefix artifacts; no expected answer, intended fix, or prior diagnosis
Forward integrity | No gold leakage into the runner prompt
Gold answers in the prompt | Gold only in meta score sheet

gaps: Integrity of the runner prompt is specified; isolation of side effects is not (see c7). That is a different gap than gold/fresh-thread integrity.

Mild tension: §3 says 'Prompt like a user: path + task, or natural multi-turn resume' while §2 forbids single-shot path-invoke as the main suite—competent agents may reintroduce lab-shaped runner prompts.
criteria.suggestion: Split runner packaging: ecological runner = prefix+verbatim probe only; lab control = path+task. Keep gold exclusively in a named score sheet location (also c7).

criteria.text: Failure labeling rules are complete, checkable, and ban invented jargon / overloaded bare nouns.

evidence.quote: Reject labels that invent scoring jargon... Reject bare overloaded nouns even if they appear once... Test: would a reader map this label to the skill meaning without a glossary?
1. Repeated in skill... 2. Daily glue only... 3. No new concepts... 4. Disambiguation... 5. Reader test

gaps: Rules are checkable for a human reviewer; no machine-checkable schema beyond prose tests—acceptable for this skill class.
criteria.suggestion: None required for c3 claim text.

criteria.text: Root-reason analysis covers layered causes and maps to caller vs callee vs harness.

evidence.quote: Harness / discovery | Caller | Callee | Goal conflict | False done ... linked to which skill file (caller vs callee) to patch first
if never loaded target skill → caller or harness first; else if loaded but wrong outcome → callee

gaps: Callee/caller binary is structural: §1 allows 'if split', but handoff and edition limits only allow patch layer: caller | callee | harness. Mono-skill (single SKILL.md is both invoke discipline and body) has no explicit layer name; agents must force-fit 'caller' or 'callee'.
Analysis layers include Goal conflict and False done, but patch-layer enum does not; root-reason.md remaps them to caller/callee edits—OK if read, easy to miss if only using handoff template.
Assumes host/callee split is the main miss geometry; misses that are pure catalog text, description, or progressive-disclosure routing are only weakly covered under harness/discovery.
criteria.suggestion: Add explicit mono-skill mapping: treat invoke/timing gates as 'caller role' and contract body as 'callee role' even inside one file; allow patch layer: skill_body with still one concern per loop.

criteria.text: Continued improvement includes surgical edition scope limits that prevent brutal full-skill rewrites.

evidence.quote: only surgical patches tied to the stated root reason... One of: caller or callee or harness config per loop... If the fix seems to need a full redesign → stop and ask the human
Root-tied only... One layer... Prefer local surgery... No drive-bys... Ask before redesign

gaps: Internal naming slip: §6 Allowed table says 'Touch only files named in the handoff `patch:` list' while the handoff template defines `patch:` as files actually touched (post-edit) and `will change` as the pre-edit list—contradicts pre-bound blast radius unless agents treat will_change as the allowlist.
criteria.suggestion: Rename consistently: pre-edit allowlist = will_change; post-edit record = patch. Forbid expanding will_change mid-loop without human OK.

criteria.text: Guidance is harness-agnostic enough to apply beyond a single CLI (Codex/Grok/others).

evidence.quote: Stay harness-agnostic: same method on Codex, Grok, Claude, Cursor, or headless CLIs.
Method stays the same; only file paths and CLI flags change. Put harness-specific paths in the case, not in this skill's core steps.
harness (codex|grok|…|any)

gaps: Examples lean Codex/Grok resume flags and session files; Claude/Cursor/headless are named but not operationalized beyond the mapping table—enough for method transfer, not plug-and-play runners.
criteria.suggestion: Optional: one-line 'how to spawn fresh thread' per harness in the case record only—do not hardcode in core steps.

criteria.text: No critical operational gap remains for a competent agent to finish a full loop (cases → score → label → root → patch → re-run → handoff).

evidence.quote: Record: pass/fail per gold observable, session/run id, artifacts paths. Done when: baseline scores exist for every case

evidence.source: references/ecological-cases.md Against lab cases + Case record
evidence.quote: Gold only in meta score sheet ... Case record fields listed ... (no path, store, or score-sheet schema)
Score observables (tool loads, files, Response shape) ... must / must not write path X ... Real project root / realistic files
fresh agent thread per case ... No gold leakage — (no workspace isolation, sandbox, restore, or cleanup)

evidence.source: SKILL.md §6 + root-reason.md When to stop / human OK
evidence.quote: stop and ask the human only for redesign / expanding edition scope — not for write-capable forward tests or accepting baseline→patch
miss_id / cases / baseline / root reason / patch layer / re-run / remaining — narrative only; no score store path, no case fixture path, no side-effect log

evidence.source: SKILL.md §6 Edition limits vs Handoff template
evidence.quote: Touch only files named in the handoff `patch:` list vs patch: (files actually touched) — pre/post list contradiction
callee and caller ... if split vs patch layer: caller | callee | harness only — mono-skill and non-split layouts underspecified for the full loop
≥1 negative case ... (no side-effect regression cases, no isolation between cases that write)

gaps: BLOCKING — No score/case persistence contract: skill requires baseline scores and gold in a 'meta score sheet' but never defines where cases, gold, baselines, or re-run comparisons live (path convention, file format, ownership).

BLOCKING — No isolation of test side effects: ecological setup prefers real project roots and gold includes must/must-not write; loop re-runs same probes on fresh threads only—filesystem/state left by case N can poison case N+1 or the skill under test.
BLOCKING — No safety procedure for write-capable forward tests: no dry-run, temp cwd, copy-on-write fixture, restore checkpoint, or forbid-list for destructive paths before spawning the runner.

BLOCKING — Human gate is only for redesign scope expansion; loop has no required human checkpoint before applying patches after a baseline, or before re-running tests that may write production-like trees.

Negative-case depth is a minimum of one non-fire; no requirement that negatives cover false-trigger and no-write obligations after a positive would have written—insufficient to claim a closed quality loop.
Step contradiction: record scores / compare re-runs, but no durable comparison artifact beyond free-text handoff lines.

Operational spawn gap: how the evaluating agent launches an unaware subagent/fresh thread is harness-left entirely to improvisation (acceptable as agnostic detail) but combined with missing score store makes 'finish a full loop' non-deterministic across agents.
criteria.suggestion: Add a minimal ops contract: (1) case+gold+scores paths under a fixed relative layout; (2) workspace isolation/restore rules for any gold that mentions writes; (3) pre-flight safety checklist for forward tests; (4) human OK only when needed for redesign already—extend optional 'human review baseline' when writes touch non-fixture trees; (5) fix will_change vs patch allowlist naming; (6) mono-skill patch-layer guidance.

open_questions: Is the intended durable artifact store the handoff blob alone, or an implied external eval harness the skill forgot to name?
Are forward tests expected to run only against disposable fixtures, despite ecological-cases.md preferring real project roots?
For mono-skills, is 'callee' the default patch layer for body failures by convention?

disputed_points_if_any.point: Whether c2 should fail because side-effect isolation is part of 'forward-test integrity'
disputed_points_if_any.position: c2 text only requires fresh threads, no gold leakage, runner not told it is testing—those are present. Isolation and write safety are operational completeness under c7, not c2 as written.
disputed_points_if_any.resolution: Failed c7 only; left c2 pass with noted tension on path+task runner wording.

disputed_points_if_any.position: c4 asks that root analysis cover layers and map to caller vs callee vs harness—the skill does. Binary force-fit for mono-skills is a completeness/usability gap (c7/c4 gaps), not a missing layer model.
disputed_points_if_any.resolution: c4 pass with gaps; c7 carries the operational miss.

disputed_points_if_any.position: c1 is about ecological generation defined and required as primary suite—yes. Depth insufficiency is a loop-quality gap under c7.
disputed_points_if_any.resolution: c1 pass; negative depth listed under c1 gaps and c7 fail evidence.
